meta.name: trojan_horse_in_troy
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: A colossal monumental wooden horse carpentered from dark pine ship timbers and oak planks (api.theme.wood.planks), standing high on a wheeled timber platform in the central plaza, with a discreet trapdoor hatch seam in its belly.
Priam's royal megaron palace of Troy: massive ashlar limestone masonry, a monumental columned Mycenaean porch facing the court, a grand bronze brazier hearth and king's high seat.
Abandoned Greek siege rampart fragments, charred ship ribs, sharpened wooden stakes, and discarded bronze shields on the beached shore camp.

tokens.terrain: a fortified citadel on a rise above a dry coastal plain; the Aegean shore in view
tokens.icons: the colossal wooden horse brought inside the walls onto the central courtyard/plaza; the massive Scaean gate and towered stone circuit wall; Priam's megaron citadel overlooking the flat-roofed city; abandoned Greek siege works and beached ship tracks on the distant shore
tokens.event_moment: dead of night, absolute silence in the slumbering city right before the hidden soldiers drop the belly hatch and emerge
